It can also be purchased from the [[Goron Gusto Shop]], the [[Coral Reef]], and the travelling merchant [[Mezer]]. Though it cannot be eaten, it can be used to make [[Meal]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]. It can also be an ingredient to make Peach [[Dye]] at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]]. Rock Salt is required in order to [[Cooking|Cook]] the following Meals: {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Food in Breath of the Wild |storedAs= Meals |columns= Item, Ingredients |rowsWith= Rock Salt |collapse= true }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Rock Salt is required in order to [[Cooking|Cook]] the following [[Meal]]s: {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Food in Tears of the Kingdom |storedAs= Meals |columns= Item, Ingredients |rowsWith= Rock Salt |collapse= true }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Descriptions EoW}} Rock Salt is an [[Ingredient]] that can be combined with another Ingredient to make a [[Smoothie]]. When used in one, it usually imbues the [[Energy Recovery]] [[Added Effect]], which causes the Smoothie to restore a portion of [[Princess Zelda]]'s [[Energy]]. Rock Salt may be found by destroying [[Rock]]s. It can also be purchased in bulk in [[Goron City]] for 30 [[Rupee]]s per piece. A portion of Rock Salt can be sold for 6 Rupees. As a reward for completing the [[Side Quest]] "[[Glide Path]]", [[Seko]] gives Zelda 10 pieces of Rock Salt, which he claims were his snack.
